examples.title: 订单规模
examples.question: 一共有多少条订单记录？
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM data

examples.title: 区域表现
examples.question: 按region分组汇总net_amount，按net_amount总和降序排列。
examples.sql: SELECT region, SUM(net_amount) AS net_total FROM data GROUP BY region ORDER BY net_total DESC

examples.title: 每月趋势
examples.question: 按order_month分组汇总net_amount，按月份升序排列。
examples.sql: SELECT order_month, SUM(net_amount) AS net_total FROM data GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month

examples.title: 渠道对比
examples.question: 按channel分组汇总net_amount，按总和降序排列。
examples.sql: SELECT channel, SUM(net_amount) AS net_total FROM data GROUP BY channel ORDER BY net_total DESC

examples.title: 品类贡献
examples.question: 按category分组汇总net_amount，按总和降序排列。
examples.sql: SELECT category, SUM(net_amount) AS net_total FROM data GROUP BY category ORDER BY net_total DESC

examples.title: 订单状态
examples.question: 按status分组统计记录数，按status升序排列。
examples.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM data GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

examples.title: 退款金额
examples.question: 只统计status精确等于已退款的refund_amount总和。
examples.sql: SELECT SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_total FROM data WHERE status='已退款'

examples.title: 完成订单客单价
examples.question: 只计算status精确等于完成的订单paid_amount平均值。
examples.sql: SELECT AVG(paid_amount) AS average_paid FROM data WHERE status='完成'

examples.title: 高金额订单
examples.question: 列出status等于完成的order_id、region和net_amount，按net_amount降序、order_id升序取前10条。
examples.sql: SELECT order_id,region,net_amount FROM data WHERE status='完成' ORDER BY net_amount DESC,order_id LIMIT 10

examples.title: 只生成 SQL
examples.question: 生成按region汇总net_amount的SQL，按region升序。
examples.sql: SELECT region,SUM(net_amount) AS net_total FROM data GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

examples.title: 空结果体验
examples.question: 列出region精确等于海外的order_id和region。
examples.sql: SELECT order_id,region FROM data WHERE region='海外'
